name: Downward Dog
instructions: From all fours, tuck your toes and lift your hips high into an inverted V.
Press your chest toward your thighs and your heels toward the floor.
Keep a slight knee bend if needed — a long spine matters more than straight legs.
cues: Stay relaxed outside the target area
longevityNotes: Mobility is use-it-or-lose-it. Ten minutes of daily joint work preserves the ranges that keep you independent — reaching, bending, and getting up from the floor.
overview: Downward Dog is a beginner mobility exercise for the hamstrings, performed with just your bodyweight. Regular mobility work keeps joints moving freely and makes strength training safer.
